tha-ap465:1.1: Citakanibbāpaka.] Ḍayhamāne sarīramhi Vessabhussa mahesino / gandhodakaṃ gahetvāna citaṃ nibbāpayim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap465:2.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe citaṃ nibbāpayim ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi gandhodakass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap465:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Citakanibbāpako th. i. g. a-ti.
